scientific_integrity: New all-field claims are proved via commutator minors, symplectic and incidence-bundle irreducibility, explicit degeneration, and matrix cube identities; finite-field checks are supplementary rather than infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Results describe geometric reduced support, not nonreduced Grassmannian or restricted-subalgebra schemes; characteristic two is not included in the restricted elementary-subalgebra component classification. Originality risks from uninspected specialized literature remain.
title: The two-component abelian-plane variety of strictly upper-triangular four-by-four matrices and its characteristic-three split
